purpose: Independently verify integrity, frozen engineering gates, component artifacts and scope locks for the already-submitted Stage2-L v12.1 factorized-R-only Job 1121553 without changing thresholds after observing its result.

expected_run.front_right_interpretation: fragile engineering cell with two train events and one dev event

independent_checks: recompute every engineering gate directly from final metrics without calling the trainer gate function
require trainer-recorded checks and pass status to equal independent recomputation at every milestone
require complete finite step history and 13 distinct train events per optimizer step
verify exact train/dev group counts and disjointness
verify checkpoint schema, step, provenance, tensor-family counts and all disabled-path flags
verify every spatial-map group and exact component-to-derived-union tensor identity
rehash frozen source, data, model, protocol, preflight, launch and attestation inputs
reject any unregistered file in the training output directory

decision_rules.integrity_failure: Classify the run as technically invalid; do not interpret metrics and do not retry automatically.
decision_rules.engineering_gate_pass: Preserve it only as a factorized-R engineering repair candidate and expand independent-event coverage before any formal or language run.
decision_rules.train_pass_dev_fail: Classify as held-out transfer failure; stop and inspect actor supervision or contextual representation instead of adding epochs.
decision_rules.learnability_or_route_retention_fail: Stop and inspect the component objective or warm-start retention; do not start language or later stages.

claim_boundary: Prospectively frozen terminal-integrity and engineering-gate audit only. It cannot establish semantic R correctness, learned U correctness, language understanding, formal generalization, planning, closed-loop behavior or safety.
